people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: David called one of the young men, and said, “Go near, and cut him down!” He struck him so that he died.
translations.bsb: Then David summoned one of the young men and said, “Go, execute him!” So the young man struck him down, and he died.
translations.kjv: And David called one of the young men, and said, Go near, and fall upon him. And he smote him that he died.
translations.asv: And David called one of the young men, and said, Go near, and fall upon him. And he smote him, so that he died.
